title: The Effects of Online Social Identity Signals on Retailer Demand
authors: Yash Babar; Ali Mahdavi Adeli; Gordon Burtch
near_miss_reason: Staggered binary label adoption exists (e.g., g_black_owned switches on in 13 distinct months for 238 places, 215 of them at the August 2020 launch; never-labelled places present), with place FE and city x month FE. But every main-text column (Table 5, Tables 6-7) regresses visits on all eight Google/Yelp identity labels jointly (additional treatments), the 'Adjusted' Table 5 columns add WeightIt propensity-score weights, and the Figure 1 event studies pass the other labels as covariates. Violation is extra treatment regressors, not time-varying controls, so not a 5c candidate; the main outcome visits_m is also withheld (SafeGraph licence).
eligible_reason: No reported specification has a single treatment indicator: all archival regressions include yelp_black_owned, g_black_owned, yelp_women_owned, g_women_owned, yelp_latinx_owned, yelp_asian_owned, g_veteran_led, g_lgbtq_friendly together. Experiments (Tables 1-3) are randomized cross-sectional. Matrix-completion (fect) and TWFE event studies are appendix (Figures E2-E6).
design_notes: R Markdown (Replication_archival.Rmd). full_panel.csv: 301,051 place-months, 6,275 SafeGraph POIs (restaurants in Chicago, Boston, Memphis areas), Jan 2018-Apr 2022. Label indicators are absorbing 0/1 by month. Adoption timing from full_panel.csv (first month == 1): g_black_owned 238 places / 13 months; yelp_black_owned 82 / 8; g_women_owned 1,205 / 25; yelp_women_owned 486 / 15; most adoptions at each feature's platform launch month. Table 5: feols(visits_m ~ 8 labels | placekey + interaction(month_range_start, cityID), cluster=~placekey) on independents, Black-verified (df_b) and women-verified (df_w) subsamples, unweighted and IPW-weighted, full window and +/-6 months around the Yelp launch. Figure 1: did2s::event_study(estimator='TWFE') with gname set to the launch month for all treated places. Tables 6-7: same specification on visitor-home-CBG race and partisanship counts.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: For g_black_owned (distinct first-label months in full_panel.csv); other labels 8-29 months, dominated by the launch-month cohort.
modern_estimator_note: did2s::event_study computes Gardner/CS/SA, but only the TWFE line is plotted (code comment shows the other estimators filtered out).

data_files_note: Readme: SafeGraph monthly-patterns variables (visits_m, median_dwell, poi_cbg, brands) require licensed access and must be merged by placekey and month_range_start; is_chain is shipped. Visitor-home CBG count outcomes for Tables 6-7 are shipped.
data_provenance_note: Shipped variables are real (author-collected labels, verified ownership, public census/voting merges); main outcome visits_m withheld.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text; Table/Figure numbers from Rmd headers). A single-label TWFE could be constructed from Tables 6-7 data, but no reported column has that form.
eligible_design_note: set to false Nov 1 ~22:05 (coding rule, PROTOCOL 5b): near-miss with no main-text specification satisfying every design rule
